[[Weng Gha]] is a [[warrior]] instructor at [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. He has an extreme dislike of the [[Tengu]] and there is little love lost with his fellow warrior instructor, [[Talon Silverwing]].

To non-Warriors:
:''"You are blessed this day, for you have met the great Weng Gha. No doubt you have heard of me, for I am famous throughout [[Cantha]] for my bravery and skill as a Warrior. My skill is second only to that of [[Headmaster Zhan|the general]], himself."''

To Warriors:
:''"You are blessed this day, for you have met the great Weng Gha. No doubt you have heard of me, for I am famous throughout Cantha for my bravery and skill as a Warrior. My skill is second only to that of the general, himself."''
